entries.claim: Separate within-scale transmission endpoints from scale-wise prediction.
entries.evidence: Actual-length independent termination and fixed-frame protocol in method; Table I(B) matched granularity.
entries.scope: Implemented frame-constrained design, not a new foundation model or entropy coder.

entries.claim: ARPC is the closest progressive source-coding precedent.
entries.evidence: ARPC paper and original implementation, cited in Introduction.
entries.scope: Not represented as an original wireless baseline or as the literal NeST implementation/codebase.

entries.claim: Known-token overwrite and recursive residual/state updates are inherited from VAR.
entries.evidence: VAR paper and implementation; explicit attribution in Introduction and II.C.
entries.scope: A0/B0/C0 are ordered mechanism interventions, not an originality proof.

entries.evidence: Table I(A); frozen policies and common500 source-paired results.
entries.scope: Family-specific calibrated operating points; exact causal granularity claim is reserved for Block B.

entries.claim: NeST has lower DISTS and DreamSim than Swin, Latent and BPG at four N1024 SNRs.
entries.scope: 500 sources, current evaluated complete systems; pixel fidelity and speed advantages of competitors retained.

entries.claim: Finer endpoint grids improve matched reconstruction with a measured cost.
entries.evidence: Table I(B), 100-source matched quality and separate timing32 observations.
entries.scope: Eighth offers a lower-cost option; no universal optimum or per-image monotonicity claim.

entries.claim: No superiority over all ordinary prefix truncation implementations is established.
entries.evidence: No such benchmark or theorem is claimed in the paper.
entries.scope: A correctly terminated, actual-length fitted prefix receiver with the same recursion may implement the same core procedure.

entries.evidence: Supplement S1/S2/S7, complete Figure S1, unchanged 92-row data and all source CSVs.
entries.scope: Display/positioning change only, no scientific-result deletion.
